key_patterns: ShotManager (scripts/shot_manager.gd) is a synchronous signal-phased pipeline: start_shot -> set_aim_target -> confirm_shot which runs _resolve_landing_tile (emits landing_resolved) -> _simulate_ball_path -> _compute_scoring synchronously; signal handlers run before later phases, so a landing_resolved handler can mutate landing_tile before scoring. Cards = CardData(Resource) with effects:Array[CardEffect]; CardEffect has apply_before_aim/on_aoe/on_landing/on_scoring/after_shot(context,upgrade_level). Modifiers dispatched via ModifierManager.apply_before_aim(ctx) etc. ShotContext(RefCounted) carries per-shot state and reset() zeroes fields. AOESystem provides _get_direction_offsets(is_odd) (0=Up..5=Up-Left), _get_neighbor_in_direction(tile,dir,is_odd), compute_circle_aoe(center,radius,hole). CLUB_STATS in hex_grid.gd keyed by ClubType (12 values) with ~10 CLUB_STATS.get(club, CLUB_STATS[ClubType.IRON_7]) fallback call sites — removing any ClubType value breaks the build.
